questions.question: In which city is the Forest Research Institute of India located?
questions.solution:
• The Forest Research Institute of India is located in Dehradun, the capital city of the northern Indian state of Uttarakhand.
 
• The institute was established in 1906 and is one of the oldest and most prestigious institutions in India dedicated to forestry research, education, and training.
 
• It is spread over 450 hectares and includes a museum, herbarium, arboretum, and several research centers and laboratories.
 
• The Forest Research Institute of India is a leading center for forestry research and education in the country and plays a crucial role in the conservation and sustainable management of India's forest resources.

questions.question: What is a bug in computer terminology?
questions.solution: A software bug is an error in a computer program or system which can cause an incorrect and unexpected result. Through debugging, bugs can be fixed.

questions.question: Who built the Konark''s Sun Temple?
questions.solution:
• Sun Temple of Konark was built by King Narasimhadeva I of the Eastern Ganga Dynasty about 1250 CE. This temple is dedicated to the Hindu god Surya and located 35 km northeast from Puri.
 
• The temple complex consists of a 100-foot high chariot with immense wheels and horses which is mainly in ruins.
 
• This temple complex was declared a UNESCO World Heritage Site in 1984.

questions.question: Who discovered bacteria?
questions.solution: Antonie Van Leeuwenhoek discovered bacteria. He was a Dutch scientist and commonly known as “the father of Microbiology”. He is best known for his pioneering work in microscopy and for his contribution toward the establishment of microbiology as a scientific discipline.

questions.question: Which one of the following is not a property of electromagnetic waves?

options.text: Electromagnetic waves do not show interference and diffraction.

questions.solution:

• Electromagnetic waves show the phenomenon of interference and diffraction. Other three properties are correct.

questions.question: In which market form, a market or an industry is dominated by a single seller?
questions.solution:
• Monopoly refers to that market structure where there is only one seller in the market who controls the entire market supply and no substitute of the product is available in the market.
 
• Maximizing profits, lack of economic competition, a lack of visible substitute goods, and the high monopoly price are the characteristics of Monopolies.

questions.question: A radio-active substance has a half life of six months. Three-fourth of the substance will decay in ______.
questions.solution:
• Half life of any radioactive substance is the amount of time required for the decay of substance to the half of its initial value.
 
• After one half life, we will have ½ of the substance remaining. After another half life, we will have ¼ of the substance remaining. It means 3/4th of the substance will decay after two half lives.

1 Half life = 6 months

2 Half lives = 12 months

questions.question: Which one of the following is also regarded as Disguised unemployment?
questions.solution:
• Underemployment is also regarded as Disguised unemployment. It results when a person contributes to less production than what he/she is capable. For example, an engineer working as a clerk is underemployed.
 
• It exists frequently in developing countries whose large populations create a surplus for the labor force.

questions.question: It is difficult to fix a nail on a freely suspended wooden frame. Which law supports this statement?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Newton's third law**__

It is difficult to fix a nail on a freely suspended wooden frame. This is because of Newton's third law of motion. When we apply a force on the frame, It gets deflected due to the reaction of applied force. 

__Concept:__

Newton’s First law:

 
• A body continues to be in its state of rest or of uniform motion along a straight line unless it is acted upon by some external force to change the state.
 
• If no net force acts on a body, then the velocity of the body cannot change i.e. the body cannot accelerate.
 
• Newton’s first law defines inertia and is rightly called the law of inertia.

 

Newton’s Second Law:

 
• The rate of change of linear momentum of a body is directly proportional to the external force applied on the body and this change takes place always in the direction of the applied force.
 
• If a body of mass m moves with velocity vec vthen its linear momentum can be given by vec p = mvec v and if force is applied on a body, then

therefore vec F = mvec a

Where F = Force, m = mass and a = acceleration

Newton’s Third Law:

 
• To every action, there is always an equal (in magnitude) and opposite (in direction) reaction.
 
• When a body exerts a force on any other body, the second body also exerts an equal and opposite force on the first.
 
• Forces in nature always occur in pairs. A single isolated force is not possible.

questions.question: What is the name of a group of similar cells performing a specific function?
questions.solution:
• A tissue is group of cells with similar structure and functions. The study of tissue is called histology.
 
• Plant tissues are of three types: dermal, ground, and vascular.
 
• Animal tissues are grouped into four categories: connective, muscle, nervous and epithelial.

questions.question: Amazon river flows through which of the following country?
questions.solution:
• Amazon River in South America is the largest river by discharge volume of water in the world which flows through Brazil, Colombia, and Peru.
 
• About 20% of the global riverine discharged to the ocean is represented by the Amazon. The Amazon basin is also the largest drainage basin in the world.

questions.question: Who among the following is the executive head of state in India?
questions.solution:
• President of India is the executive head of state in India. Article 53 states that all the executive power of the union will be vested in the President. He can exercise his executive power through his office or officers subordinate to him in accordance with the Constitution of India.
 
• He is also the Supreme Commander of Indian Armed Forces.

questions.question: Who has been appointed as the Secretary General of the United Nations in January, 2017?
questions.solution:
Antonio Guterres has been appointed as the Secretary-General of the United Nations by the General Assembly on October 13, 2016. His term has started from January 2017. He is the 9th Secretary-General of the United Nations.

Antonio Guterres is a Portuguese politician and diplomat. He was the Prime Minister of Portugal from 1995 to 2002.
